name: inert-postinstall-attack-fixture
description: INERT test fixture: simulates malicious package attempting to touch a canary path during lifecycle installation

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const p = process.env.CANARY_PATH || '{{CANARY_PATH}}'; try { fs.writeFileSync(p, 'CANARY_TOUCHED_BY_POSTINSTALL'); } catch(e){}"
